text_block_list.text: One day, while walking near the mall's arcade corner—

text_block_list.name: Protesting Boy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let me play too!
There are only two arcade cabinets for this, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Bratty Kid
text_block_list.text:
Heh, get lost, scrub!
Weaklings don't get the right to play!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: —Um, excuse me...?

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
If everyone took turns nicely and got along—
it would be so much friendlier, and surely much more fun...

text_block_list.name: Bratty Kid
text_block_list.text:
Aaah? Shut up!
If you wanna kick me off, try beating me first!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
Um—in that case, if I can play this game,
you will listen to what I have to say, right?
choice_data_list: ...Can you play it? Looks like a fighting game, though.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
............I'm not very confident, but...
first, we must try to reach a compromise.
And so, Karen Bouquet Doll challenged the match with awkward, unaccustomed hands—

text_block_list.name: Bratty Kid
text_block_list.text:
Heh, forget a match, you can't even land a single hit!
Come back after you at least learn how to punch!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry. Even if it's just a game—
I hesitated to inflict violence.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: However... unless I attack... the opponent's character, I cannot win. ...Nnn—

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
............
I will try to find a way somehow.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
...I see. There's a secret technique like this—
Let me take notes...

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
...Just as the rumors say, this arcade seems to have
many cabinets for that game.
I'll train here and—

And so—the rematch was set.
The agreement was that if Karen Bouquet Doll won,
the kids would share and take turns amicably.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: Now then—I look forward to our match.

text_block_list.name: Bratty Kid
text_block_list.text:
Take this! Big Bang Thousand Hands!
Lightning Vortex Thunder Kick!!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: Ngh, hop... hop...!

text_block_list.name: Spectating Children
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Whaaat!? She's dodging every single attack
just by timing her bows properly!?

text_block_list.name: Bratty Kid
text_block_list.text:
Damn it, bobbing up and down like a bamboo water fountain!
But just dodging ain't gonna make you win!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
...Almost 20 dodges in a row...!
—Now!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
↑, ↓, ↓, ←, A, B, B, →...
Secret Command, activate!!

text_block_list.name: Bouquet's Character
text_block_list.text:
Wickedness dwells within your fists...
From now on... use those fists for the sake of love!

text_block_list.name: Bratty Kid
text_block_list.text: Wh-What!? M-My character... became a monk and entered the priesthood!?

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
Since this character is a monk...
by dodging 20 times in a row, you can persuade the opponent
and claim victory—that is the hidden move available.

text_block_list.name: Bratty Kid
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's so cheap!
You're banned from using that character next round!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: Yes... that is not a problem.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
...On this stage, that technique can be used.
While dodging with just-frame bows—

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
B, →, →, A, A, A, ←...
Borrow a smartphone from an audience member in the background—
"Call 110" activated!!

text_block_list.name: Bratty Kid
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Whaaaat!?
My character got escorted away in a police car!?

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
...How was that?
That should count as consecutive wins... right?

text_block_list.name: Bratty Kid
text_block_list.text:
A-Awesome~! Big sis,
how do you know so many secret cheats!?

text_block_list.name: Excited Children
text_block_list.text:
"Teach us, teach us!"
"M-Me too!"

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Of course, I don't mind.
...However.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
—From now on, let's take turns nicely
and share the cabinets. It's a promise, okay?
choice_data_list: You've become the boss of the kids...
Even though it was outside your comfort zone, you did great.
Even though it was outside your comfort zone, you did great.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
—From now on, let's take turns nicely
and share the cabinets. It's a promise, okay?

Even though it was outside your comfort zone, you did great.
Even though it was outside your comfort zone, you did great.

text_block_list.name: Excited Children
text_block_list.text:
"Okaay!" "Got it!"
"Hurry and teach us!" "Hey! I was first!"

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's alright... I will make sure
to teach every single one of you properly—

Despite it being an unfamiliar genre, through sheer effort,
Karen Bouquet Doll had splendidly "bound together"
the children as one.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
It took some time, but...
because it had such depth, it wasn't painful at all.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
To win by persuading rather than hurting the opponent...
To think fighting games have methods like that too.
choice_data_list: ...I think it's just this particular game that's weird.

text_block_list.text:
At any rate, Karen Bouquet Doll had splendidly mediated the dispute
and brought about perfect harmony.
